evaluation.strategy: two non-overlapping fixed-origin recursive six-month folds
evaluation.training_rule: training targets strictly earlier than each origin
evaluation.aggregate_metric_definition: pooled micro metrics across all eligible product-month targets; aggregate R2 can be dominated by between-product level differences

excluded_features: prices: unit consistency and future availability are not established
economic/operating covariates: future values or as-of vintages are not supplied
aliases: source series remain separate pending domain confirmation
model.recursive_strategy: only prior observations before origin, then prior predictions; held-out actuals are not fed back

assumptions_and_limitations: Synthetic/demo data only; source provenance is unavailable.
Reviewed aliases are not merged; only configured primary source labels are modeled.
Ambiguous slash dates and invalid targets are audited and excluded, never guessed or imputed.
Pricing and exogenous market features are not used; their future availability is unverified.
R2 is blank when a metric group has fewer than two samples or zero actual variance.
This is a new replacement methodology, not the original model or an assertion of model validity.
